label: Dashboard Auth Basic
summary: Local basic-auth provider surface for control plane soft simulation.
description: Wave 6 trust fabric plugin. Exposes dashboard.auth.basic.* capabilities for soft simulation of control-plane basic auth. Does NOT replace a real auth server — plugin surface only. Never returns password values.

capabilities.label: Basic Auth Status
capabilities.summary: Report whether DASHBOARD_BASIC_USER / DASHBOARD_BASIC_PASSWORD are configured (booleans only).

capabilities.label: Basic Auth Verify
capabilities.summary: Compare username/password to env with constant-time-ish equality. Never echoes password.

capabilities.label: Basic Auth Challenge
capabilities.summary: Return WWW-Authenticate style challenge hint for Basic realm zavorth.

permissions.reason: Read whether DASHBOARD_BASIC_USER / DASHBOARD_BASIC_PASSWORD are set (not the values).
